memories.text: Olga Petrova owns the Sluice cache.
Cedar releases ship on Monday.
Nikhil Rao is the Marlin lead.
Marlin releases ship on Wednesday.
Liam Oconnor owns the Relay gateway.
Yusuf Demir is the Juniper lead.
Juniper releases ship on Friday.
Pablo Reyes owns the Hopper ingest service.
Hiro Tanaka is the Osprey lead.
Osprey releases ship on Tuesday.
Kavya Menon owns the Anvil builder.
Vera Kovac is the Tamarind lead.
Tamarind releases ship on Thursday.
Greta Lindqvist owns the Conduit stream.
Vesper releases ship on Monday.
Wen Zhao is the Pinnacle lead.
Pinnacle releases ship on Wednesday.
Sven Larsen owns the Turret API.
Bruno Keller is the Quartz lead.
Quartz releases ship on Friday.
Tara Brennan owns the Cobalt auth service.
Rania Said owns the Ferry queue.
Dmitri Volkov is the Thistle lead.
Mila Novak owns the Lattice store.
Jonas Weiss is the Umbra lead.
Chiara Rossi is the Willow lead.
Failed Cedar jobs are retried 8 times before they are parked.
Failed Marlin jobs are retried 11 times before they are parked.
Failed Juniper jobs are retried 9 times before they are parked.
Failed Osprey jobs are retried 12 times before they are parked.
Failed Tamarind jobs are retried 10 times before they are parked.
Failed Vesper jobs are retried 8 times before they are parked.
The Osprey rollback window is 60 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Tamarind rollback window is 55 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Vesper rollback window is 50 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Pinnacle rollback window is 45 minutes after a failed deploy.
The Quartz rollback window is 70 minutes after a failed deploy.
As of March, the Cedar default model was Merlin-7B.
As of October, the Cedar default model is Kestrel-3B; the Merlin-7B model has been retired.
As of March, the Marlin default model was Swift-6B.
As of October, the Marlin default model is Merlin-7B; the Swift-6B model has been retired.
As of March, the Juniper default model was Heron-4B.
As of October, the Juniper default model is Kestrel-9B; the Heron-4B model has been retired.
As of March, the Osprey default model was Swift-20B.
As of October, the Osprey default model is Heron-4B; the Swift-20B model has been retired.
Nimbus Metrics support hours are 7 to 6 on weekdays.
Falconer Logs support hours are 9 to 6 on weekdays.
Brightwell Mail support hours are 8 to 6 on weekdays.

documents.title: Cedar architecture
documents.content:
# Overview
Cedar is an internal platform. It runs scheduled jobs and serves interactive requests.

# Jobs
Jobs flow through the Sluice cache. A failed job is retried up to 3 times before it is parked.

# Model serving
Cedar serves Kestrel-3B on the GPU host. Interactive requests use the fast path and scheduled jobs use the deep path.

# Storage
The Sluice cache is limited to 20 GB per tenant.

documents.title: Cedar runbook
documents.content:
# Deploy
Deploy Cedar with the release script and watch the dashboard for 5 minutes.

# Rollback
Roll back within 15 minutes of a failed deploy by running the rollback script.
